questions.prompt: Which of these are woodwind instruments?
questions.fact: A saxophone is made of brass but counts as woodwind, because a reed makes its sound.

questions.prompt: Which of these are fruits, to a botanist?
questions.fact: A fruit is the part that holds the seeds, which is why a tomato counts and a carrot does not.

questions.prompt: How many pieces does each player start a game of chess with?
questions.fact: Sixteen: eight pawns, two rooks, two knights, two bishops, a queen and a king.

questions.prompt: How deep can an emperor penguin dive, in metres?
questions.fact: Over 500 metres, and it can hold its breath for more than twenty minutes doing it.

questions.prompt: Which empire built the Taj Mahal?
questions.hint: The same empire ruled most of the Indian subcontinent for three centuries.
questions.fact: Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal. It took about twenty years.

questions.prompt: What does a Geiger counter measure?
questions.hint: The clicking sound is the giveaway.
questions.fact: Each click is one particle striking the tube, so a faster clicking means a stronger source.
